_note: The web build's UPDATING screen (app/web_update.rs state, ui/update_screen.rs drawing). When the deployed version.json differs from the one the page loaded with (dist/web/update.js), a full-screen overlay counts `countdown_seconds` down and reloads the page; UPDATE NOW reloads at once; LATER (offered only during a run) hides the screen for `postpone_seconds`, then it comes back. `max_step_seconds` caps one frame's time so a tab coming back from the background does not skip the countdown. Strings are shown as written; `countdown_line` must contain {n}, the whole seconds left. Poll timing (30 s plus up to 10 s of jitter) is in packaging/web/update.js.
